# Macau Civil Service Exam Practice (macau430.com)

> Free Traditional Chinese practice for Macau SAR government 430 and 260 comprehensive ability assessments (綜合能力評估). Not affiliated with SAFP.

- Site: https://macau430.com/
- Canonical: https://macau430.com/
- Language: zh-TW (Traditional Chinese)
- Audience: Candidates preparing for Macau public service open exams (公職開考)
- Content: Law, math, charts, logic, reading comprehension — practice quizzes with explanations
- Official exam info: http://concurso-uni.safp.gov.mo/

## Main pages

- Home: https://macau430.com/
- About / FAQ: https://macau430.com/about
- Choose exam (430 or 260): https://macau430.com/exam
- 430 practice hub: https://macau430.com/practice/430
- 260 practice hub: https://macau430.com/practice/260
- Challenge mode: https://macau430.com/challenge
- Spaced review (wrong questions): https://macau430.com/review
- Wrong-question notebook: https://macau430.com/wrong

## Exam types (summary)

- **430 統考** — Bachelor-degree level comprehensive assessment (學士學位程度綜合能力評估開考); categories: law, math, charts, logic, reading. Reference format in this app: ~58 questions, 100 points, 50 to pass (practice scoring).
- **260 統考** — Technician-level comprehensive assessment (技術員程度綜合能力評估開考); same subject categories for practice.

## Disclaimer

Practice-only study tool. Question banks include community recall and study materials. For official syllabus, dates, and rules, use the Macau SAFP concurso site above.
